messages:
maria: quick sync — finalizing release notes for RC 2026.03.20. Need copy signoff + pin schedule by EOD. snippets below. @alex @devex_lead @sre-oncall

alex: on it, will scan now. main ask: confirm the rollback phrasing + which routes are pinned to v2.1 during canary.

devex_lead: I pulled the copy. overall good. two tiny wording tweaks (see inline). otherwise ready to publish to internal channel once we lock timing. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks. inline snippet: 
```
Release Candidate: 2026.03.20-rc
Highlights: improved batching latency for long context use, fallback to quantized v2.0 for heavy load, and new per-route cost breakdown in Console.
Impact: no model API changes. Behavior change only under heavy concurrency when fallback triggers.
Rollout: Canary 21:00 UTC (20% traffic), ramp to 100% over 2h if no regressions.
Rollback: immediate rollback to pinned v2.0 variant; SLOs unchanged.
```

sre-oncall: want to confirm rollback lane: who triggers and what metric gates? propose: deploy-bot auto-rollback if error rate >= 3% for 5m OR median p95 latency increase > 25% for 5m. manual fallback allowed by oncall.

alex: yep that's fine. also add a short note to RN about pinned routes: `/api/generate` and `/api/stream` pinned to v2.1-canary, `/api/large-embed` pinned to v2.0-quantized as fallback.

maria: updated. new snippet: 
```
Pinning: /api/generate, /api/stream -> v2.1-canary (21:00 UTC)
/api/large-embed -> v2.0-quantized (always as fallback)
Deploybot cues: canary start, canary-ready, auto-rollback, manual-rollback
```

deploy-bot: [info] scheduled deployment: rc-2026.03.20 -> canary at 2026-03-20T21:00:00Z. Notification channels: #eng-releases, #oncall-alerts. Auto-rollback configured with gates: 5m error-rate and latency monitors.

sre-oncall: confirm alerting play: page oncall at 2x error rate threshold and create incident for any auto-rollback. Also will run preflight against synthetic prompt set at +10m before canary.

devex_lead: copy for internal announce (one-liner): 
"Deploying RC 2026.03.20: latency improvements and failover to quantized fallback under heavy load. Canary 21:00 UTC; see internal docs for pinning and rollback details." 

maria: perfect. final ask: @alex can you merge RN and pinning note to the internal kb (release/2026-03-20) and ping me when done? I'll post the internal announce after merge.

alex: will do, merging in 10. ping once merged and I'll trigger the deploybot queue if needed.

maria: thanks everyone. I'll post internal announcement at 18:30 UTC and add the deploy window + playbook link. :white_check_mark:
